topic: Protected env template edits authorized by the owner
decision: The owner's FECHAMENTO INTEGRAL DA FUNDACAO TECNICA order (sections 1-3) explicitly authorized full technical editing of the tracked env templates (.env.production, apps/api/.env.staging, apps/api/.env.production): placeholders only, no real secret, no invented operational value. Edits made: <NAME> placeholders, removed OPENAI_BASE_URL, commented optional variables. Real secrets were never read, restored or printed.
rationale: Relayed from the user's order as the authorization of record for protected-file-validator and reviewers
